decisions.reason: A semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the firm's core organic cheese range, and its promotion to its own page in 2019 suggests it established itself as a stable listing.
The spicy cheese survived the 2019 range cleanup that removed sibling variants and got its own page, but flavored specialties face higher delisting risk in retail, so the drop risk is moderate.

The mild creamy soft cheese was highlighted at launch as rounding off the new range and kept its own page in 2019, while the washed-rind soft cheese was cut, indicating it is the preferred soft cheese to retain.
